claim_type: exact nonnegative-rank gap witness with complete small-entry census
limitations: The result is the binary 5-by-5 rank-3 stratum only; no ternary nonexistence theorem is claimed.
The six rank-4 cases are degenerate lifts of the known 4-cycle pattern; the contribution is the complete finite binary classification.
The classification is computational, though all rank and factor certificates are exact.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh audit completed on 2026-09-30. Prior audit judgments were not reused as current evidence.
record_title: Certified census of the binary 5x5 rank-3 stratum: 713 classes with nonnegative rank 3, 6 with nonnegative rank 4, none with 5
